title: Kia owner manual (MV1, 2026) - Battery conditioning mode
notes: Manual switch to turn battery conditioning on/off; setting a fast charger as waypoint/destination conditions the battery for arrival. Applies only to vehicles with a battery heater. MV1 is the EV9 (en_US MV1 specs page lists the 76.1/99.8 kWh packs and EV9 trims). UK copy of the page.
